source: Per-city local circumstances: https://www.timeanddate.com/eclipse/ (Madrid, Reykjavik, London pages)
attribution: Eclipse Predictions by Fred Espenak, NASA's GSFC
notes: Times are local wall-clock times on the eclipse date in the given IANA timezone.
Madrid and Reykjavik values cross-checked against NASA + timeanddate (agree).
London magnitude is not published by NASA/timeanddate; assert times and obscuration only.
Sydney is the negative case: the eclipse is not visible there; expect EclipseView null.
Madrid's partial phase ends after sunset; NASA publishes 21:16 CEST (ends-at-sunset variant 21:19). The geometric end per astronomy-engine is ~21:24 CEST, so Madrid uses partialEndToleranceMin: 10.
Position angles (PA) not yet asserted; extract from NASA per-eclipse local-circumstances tables if needed.
